permissions.name: View dashboard
permissions.description: Open the dashboard.

permissions.name: View all projects
permissions.description: See every project (and its commercial records), not only projects the user manages, created, belongs to or has tasks in.

permissions.name: Create projects
permissions.description: Create new projects / sites.

permissions.name: Edit projects
permissions.description: Edit details and members of accessible projects.

permissions.name: Archive projects
permissions.description: Archive and restore accessible projects.

permissions.name: Post project status
permissions.description: Write current-status updates on accessible projects.

permissions.name: Manage departments
permissions.description: Create, edit and deactivate departments and their memberships.

permissions.name: View team directory
permissions.description: See the full team member directory and profiles.

permissions.name: Manage team members
permissions.description: Create and edit non-administrator accounts, activate/deactivate them and issue password-reset links.

permissions.name: Manage administrators
permissions.description: Create administrators and change any account's role.

permissions.name: View all tasks
permissions.description: See every task in the organization.

permissions.name: Create tasks
permissions.description: Create and assign tasks on accessible projects.

permissions.name: Manage tasks
permissions.description: Edit, reassign and cancel tasks on accessible projects.

permissions.name: Update assigned tasks
permissions.description: Update status and progress of tasks assigned to the user.

permissions.name: Comment on tasks
permissions.description: Add comments to visible tasks.

permissions.name: Task reports
permissions.description: Print / export / share project, department, member and global task lists within the user's access.

permissions.name: Own task report
permissions.description: Print / export the user's own task list.

permissions.name: Commercial reports & exports
permissions.description: Run and export procurement, stock, billing and accounts reports (rows still limited to accessible projects).

permissions.name: View inventory
permissions.description: See items, brands, locations, stock balances and the stock ledger.

permissions.name: Manage items & brands
permissions.description: Create, edit and deactivate items and brands, link brands, set HSN/GST and reorder levels.

permissions.name: Manage stock locations
permissions.description: Create and edit warehouses and site stores.

permissions.name: Post stock inward / outward
permissions.description: Record manual stock received (inward) and issued (outward).

permissions.name: Stock adjustments
permissions.description: Post opening stock, adjustments, physical-count variances and reversals (a reason is mandatory).

permissions.name: Reserve stock
permissions.description: Reserve and release stock for projects.

permissions.name: Transfers & challans
permissions.description: Create, dispatch and cancel delivery challans / stock transfers and returns.

permissions.name: Record site consumption
permissions.description: Record material consumed / installed at a project site.

permissions.name: View clients & suppliers
permissions.description: See the client and supplier directory.

permissions.name: Manage clients & suppliers
permissions.description: Create and edit clients and suppliers, GST and bank details.

permissions.name: View material planning
permissions.description: See project material requirements, availability and shortages.

permissions.name: Manage material requirements
permissions.description: Add and edit project material requirements.

permissions.name: View purchase requisitions
permissions.description: See purchase requisitions.

permissions.name: Raise purchase requisitions
permissions.description: Create, edit and submit purchase requisitions.

permissions.name: Approve purchase requisitions
permissions.description: Approve or reject submitted requisitions.

permissions.name: View rate enquiries
permissions.description: See rate enquiries, supplier quotations and comparisons.

permissions.name: Manage rate enquiries
permissions.description: Create RFQs, record supplier quotations and propose awards.

permissions.name: Approve RFQ awards
permissions.description: Approve or reject proposed supplier awards before POs are raised.

permissions.name: View purchase orders
permissions.description: See purchase orders.

permissions.name: Create purchase orders
permissions.description: Create, edit, submit, send and amend purchase orders.

permissions.name: Approve purchase orders
permissions.description: Approve or reject purchase orders (within approval limits).

permissions.name: Cancel / close purchase orders
permissions.description: Cancel or short-close purchase orders.

permissions.name: View site receipts
permissions.description: See GRNs / site material receipts and challans.

permissions.name: Capture site receipts
permissions.description: Record received quantities, photos and signed challans and submit them for verification.

permissions.name: Verify & post GRNs
permissions.description: Verify submitted receipts and post them to stock.

permissions.name: Reverse posted GRNs
permissions.description: Reverse a posted GRN (creates reversal stock entries).

permissions.name: View supplier bills
permissions.description: See supplier invoices and their matching status.

permissions.name: Enter supplier bills
permissions.description: Enter, edit and submit supplier bills and supplier credit/debit notes.

permissions.name: Approve supplier bills
permissions.description: Approve supplier bills for payment.

permissions.name: Override match exceptions
permissions.description: Approve a bill despite PO/GRN match exceptions (reason mandatory).

permissions.name: View payments & receipts
permissions.description: See supplier payments and client receipts.

permissions.name: Record payments & receipts
permissions.description: Record supplier payments / client receipts, allocate and reverse them.

permissions.name: Project accounts
permissions.description: See project financial summaries, ledgers and aging.

permissions.name: View client POs
permissions.description: See client purchase orders / contracts.

permissions.name: Manage client POs
permissions.description: Create, edit, submit and amend client purchase orders.

permissions.name: Approve client POs
permissions.description: Approve client POs and their amendments / variations.

permissions.name: View sales orders
permissions.description: See sales orders.

permissions.name: Manage sales orders
permissions.description: Create, edit, submit and amend sales orders.

permissions.name: Approve sales orders
permissions.description: Approve, cancel and close sales orders.

permissions.name: View running bills
permissions.description: See RA bills, measurements and certifications.

permissions.name: Prepare running bills
permissions.description: Prepare RA bills and measurements and submit them for internal review.

permissions.name: Review & submit running bills
permissions.description: Internally approve RA bills and mark them submitted to the client.

permissions.name: Record client certification
permissions.description: Record client-certified quantities, deductions and disputes.

permissions.name: View client invoices
permissions.description: See client tax invoices.

permissions.name: Prepare client invoices
permissions.description: Draft client invoices and client credit notes.

permissions.name: Issue client invoices
permissions.description: Approve / issue and cancel client invoices.

permissions.name: Verify evidence
permissions.description: Mark attached proofs (photos, signed challans, invoices) verified or rejected.

permissions.name: Approvals inbox
permissions.description: See the cross-module approvals inbox (only items the user may act on).

permissions.name: Commercial settings
permissions.description: Company GST identity, numbering series, matching tolerances, approval limits and locations.

permissions.name: Company settings
permissions.description: Edit company name, logo and contact details.

permissions.name: Roles & permissions
permissions.description: Change which permissions each role has.

permissions.name: Audit log
permissions.description: View the organization audit log.
